investigation_notes.Description: A Vitalis Healthcare brand logo was detected on the domain vitalislab-diagnostics.de. The scanned URL indicates a page likely belonging to Vitalis Healthcare branding, which may reflect brand monitoring or legitimate association rather than impersonation. The domain resolves to 104.26.10.224 (likely Cloudflare) and has an age of about 7 years with NameCheap, Inc. as registrar. Based on the visual match to the reference logo and absence of suspicious indicators, the alert is classified as Low Priority.
